raw_source:
def circular_shift(x, shift):
    s = str(abs(x))          # work with absolute value; sign not specified in examples
    n = len(s)
    
    if shift > n:            # "If shift > number of digits, return digits reversed."
        return s[::-1]
    
    k = shift % n            # handle shifts larger than one full rotation (optional but safe)
    rotated = s[-k:] + s[:-k]  # right circular shift by k positions
    
    if x < 0:                # preserve sign if original was negative
        return "-" + rotated
    return rotated
